scope: Public library exports; ref.* recipes belong to the API reference, not the Telegram method snapshot

groups.title: Конфигурация и проверенный запуск
groups.limits: HMAC fixture без Telegram; token только на backend, raw initData проверяется до session/ACL. BotSettings repr скрывает token, сериализация не становится безопасной. VerifiedLaunch — результат проверки, ручной DTO не подтверждает identity.

telegram_patterns.BotSettings: Конфигурация из явного environ без dotenv

groups.title: Безопасные сообщения и длинный текст
groups.limits: SDK-free/entities payload с parse_mode=None. Консервативный UTF-16 limit; atomic oversized entity/Unicode sequence вызывает error. Общие emoji/combining sequences сохранены, полная UAX29 segmentation не обещана. Host проверяет link trust, sticker/fallback metadata и custom emoji entitlement/context; default — regular emoji. Никаких network/retry/delivery/ACL promises.

telegram_patterns.EntityKind: Literal одиннадцати поддерживаемых outgoing entity типов
telegram_patterns.MessageBuilder: Immutable fluent literal composition и rebased entities
telegram_patterns.utf16_length: Валидация scalars и подсчет UTF-16 units
telegram_patterns.split_formatted: Lossless partition, clipping styles/code и atomic links/quotes/emoji

groups.title: SQLite effect и повтор
groups.limits: Scope/ACL определяет сервер до effect и replay. Atomicity касается только переданного SQLite connection: без HTTP, другого storage, commit/rollback. Файл/миграции/retention принадлежат host.

telegram_patterns.OperationConflict: Тот же scoped key с другим payload
telegram_patterns.SQLiteOnce: Инициализация и атомарный run в файле SQLite

groups.title: Безопасные ошибки и восстановление
groups.limits: Передавайте реальный operation kind. Report не копирует developer text и не делает retry. Timeout/cancel/невалидный feedback после возможной записи оставляют unknown outcome и требуют сверки той же операции; локальный отказ должен произойти до эффекта.

telegram_patterns.InvalidType: Локальный type отказ, совместимый с TypeError
telegram_patterns.AuthenticationRequired: Известный отказ до эффекта из-за отсутствия auth
telegram_patterns.PermissionDenied: Известный отказ до эффекта по правам
telegram_patterns.TimeoutFailure: Ожидание истекло, outcome зависит от операции
telegram_patterns.TransportFailure: Ошибка transport без обещания отмены записи

groups.title: Transport и provider интерфейсы проекта
groups.limits: Структурные Protocol не создают ресурсы и не обещают provider idempotency. Fixture отвергает все события; реальный adapter проверяет официальный wire/auth contract. Signed event не означает оплату/доступ, refund — отдельная операция.

groups.title: Поиск в поставляемом cookbook
groups.limits: Чтение не исполняет recipe code. Maturity отдельно от verification; SDK/mock не доказывают live/device. Preview — независимая копия. Этот пример ищет существующий cookbook recipe two-columns; ref.* — имена справочника API.

groups.title: Требования и явная offline проверка
groups.limits: Только установленный доверенный wheel и закрытые fixtures. Plan не читает secret values. Runner не исполняет recipe.code/приложение; native references отказывает до child. Python -I/-B, системный env allowlist, временный cwd; это не OS sandbox. Нет live rights/auth/device acceptance.

telegram_patterns.RecipeRunPlan: Неизменяемые требования offline/live и причины недоступности
telegram_patterns.RecipeRunResult: Результат известной локальной fixture без Telegram requests
telegram_patterns.run_recipe_offline: Явный изолированный запуск известной Python fixture

groups.title: Новый проект из предоставленного wheel
groups.limits: Дополнительный аргумент — путь к предоставленному wheel, не имя в registry. Только новый target и существующий parent; dry-run без записи, repeat сохраняет код. Closed starter registry не заменяет host backend/auth; I/O failure может оставить partial new files.

telegram_patterns.starter_components: Каталог closed starter групп для шаблона
telegram_patterns.create_starter: Dry-run и исключительное создание нового проекта

groups.title: Read-only diagnosis в SDK-free окружении
groups.limits: Пример намеренно запускается без aiogram: readiness fail содержит команды следующего явного действия. Без webhook=True doctor не читает .env, не обращается к сети и не подтверждает live identity; webhook=True делает один read-only getWebhookInfo с BOT_TOKEN из окружения или .env проекта. Предлагаемые repairs не выполняются, token не попадает в отчет. SDK probe установленного extra изолирован от проекта.

telegram_patterns.cli.doctor: Локальные checks с reason/remediation и exit readiness

groups.title: Клавиатуры, ввод и страницы
groups.limits: Aiogram extra; callbacks до 64 bytes, keys bounded ASCII, prefixes навигации и action различимы. Colors только primary/success/danger, emoji entitlement отдельный. Контекст chat/business/invoice передает host. Reply не вызывает callback_query; appearance в Telegram не проверяется.

telegram_patterns.aiogram.action_menu: Равномерные строки по 2/3 и другое число
telegram_patterns.aiogram.KeyboardLayout: Immutable 2/3/mixed width pattern with last/cycle tail
telegram_patterns.aiogram.KeyboardCapabilities: Explicit context and presentation hints; unknown uses standard text fallback
telegram_patterns.aiogram.action_layout: Unique callback descriptors composed by width pattern
telegram_patterns.aiogram.inline_layout: Flat native inline buttons with context checks and fallback
telegram_patterns.aiogram.reply_layout: Flat reply buttons with request validation and fallback

groups.title: Команды и callback композиция
groups.limits: Добавляйте Router в существующий Dispatcher. Command menu устанавливается явно с выбранным scope. ACK убирает spinner, service проверяет actor/object/revision/idempotency. Notify выбирает безопасный доступный канал; пример использует только synthetic private message.

telegram_patterns.aiogram.ActionResult: Статус и публичный plain ответ сервиса
telegram_patterns.aiogram.command_router: Reply handlers с SDK mention filtering

telegram_patterns.testing.Responder: Typed fixture value или sync/async callable
telegram_patterns.testing.StubSession: Явные responses, calls, close без HTTP fallback

groups.title: Polling lifecycle и Stars request
groups.limits: SDK polling через StubSession завершается после первого запроса; ни реального token, ни удаления webhook. Live требует отдельного процесса и проверки consumer/webhook. Runner закрывает session после успешного preflight. create_bot с test_environment=True направляет запросы в отдельное тестовое окружение Telegram; переданная session должна уже использовать TEST. Stars request не создает оплату, заказ или entitlement; consent и server ledger у host.

groups.title: Ввод, review и owner-bound submit
groups.limits: Private chat, 1..10 уникальных TextField, включенный actor-scoped FSM isolation. Max_length в UTF-16; validator synchronous. MemoryStorage и list — fixture, не durable заявка. Service проверяет ACL и эффект/replay; unknown outcome сохраняет operation identity до сверки.

telegram_patterns.aiogram.InvalidField: Bounded plain ошибка пользователя без секретов

groups.title: Metadata событий и фаз
groups.limits: Observer регистрируется на dispatcher.update. IDs opt-in; без текста/contacts/initData/raw exception. Best-effort не durable inbox/audit. Router subscription/rights/allowed_updates и ACK/auth остаются у host, Bot API не читает историю user account.

telegram_patterns.aiogram.event_router: Handlers по точным SDK kind names

groups.title: SDK catalog и request construction
groups.limits: Catalog отражает установленный SDK, не server rights. Builder отклоняет неизвестные top-level fields; nested validation принадлежит SDK. InputFile не читается автоматически. HTTP/send/лимиты/доступ и provider workflow не появляются от construction.

telegram_patterns.aiogram.InvalidAPIRequest: Контролируемый отказ без SDK payload dump

groups.title: Theme bridge, shell и поле ввода
groups.limits: ESM + DOM + явно подключенный styles.css. Native объект synthetic; snapshot не auth. Host разрешает coordinates insets и владеет состоянием/navigation/focus. Shell/field используют textContent; dispose удаляет только own UI/subscriptions. Viewport не physical Telegram QA.

groups.title: HTTP client с decoder и unknown write
groups.limits: Response/fetch synthetic, реального backend нет. Trusted baseUrl и same-origin paths; runtime decode обязательно. Headers/session/CSRF/ACL/idempotency у host. Один invocation транспорта не исключает wire replay браузером. Unknown POST сверяется с тем же ключом без автоматического retry.

groups.title: Выбор с TTL и storage fallback
groups.limits: Только serviceId/slotId, без auth/contacts/price/pending operation. Account scope должен поступать от server host; fixture scope не авторизация. Store не меняет scope автоматически при account switch. Storage sync; async CloudStorage требует другого adapter, failure дает unavailable/false.

@awesome-telegram/patterns.DraftRead: Discriminated status с value только restored

groups.title: Native availability и listener cleanup
groups.limits: Каталоги и facade не являются полной parameter schema. Presence/platform/version не consent, launch, auth или успешный платеж. Callback и receiver сохраняются; host выбирает arguments/permissions. Listener/dispose подавляют late callbacks, native cleanup failure может требовать повторного dispose.

groups.title: Safe errors и typed recovery
groups.limits: Developer messages не сериализуются в safe report. Operation kind отражает реальное действие; unknown write требует reconcile, classification не отменяет effect. InvalidType сохраняет TypeError catch, а не наследование PatternError. Type aliases не валидируют произвольный JSON автоматически.

@awesome-telegram/patterns.safeErrorReport: Allowlisted error metadata без raw exception

groups.title: Экраны и история в одном сообщении
groups.limits: Optional aiogram. Owner/bot/chat/thread/message/revision guards, ACK first, unknown edit freeze and explicit same-message recovery. State lives in one process/event loop; restart leaves old buttons stale. Host owns sessions/tasks and business ACL. No automatic resend after unknown initial send; no live UI proof.

telegram_patterns.aiogram.NavigationScreen: Immutable plain screen with declared links/layout
telegram_patterns.aiogram.MessageNavigation: Bounded open/get_state/handle/discard lifecycle for one owned message
telegram_patterns.aiogram.navigation_router: SDK Router with ACK-first guarded navigation and optional feedback

groups.title: Серверные значения и подтверждение выбора
groups.limits: Single-process server draft; exact owner/context/revision and confirmation token guards. No automatic business operation, persistence or multiworker guarantee. Current ACL/resource_version/idempotency transaction belongs to host; synthetic transport does not prove live delivery or rendering.

telegram_patterns.SelectionOption: Immutable keyed option and filter membership
telegram_patterns.SelectionSpec: Current server values, field bounds and resource version
telegram_patterns.SelectionState: Immutable draft snapshot, summary and bounded callback code
telegram_patterns.SelectionResult: Guarded selection decision with safe feedback
telegram_patterns.SelectionMenu: Atomic server draft, rule refresh and revision-bound one-time confirmation

groups.title: Составная клавиатура и Router выбора
groups.limits: Single-process server draft; exact owner/context/revision and confirmation token guards. No automatic business operation, persistence or multiworker guarantee. Current ACL/resource_version/idempotency transaction belongs to host; synthetic transport does not prove live delivery or rendering.

telegram_patterns.aiogram.selection_keyboard: Render toggle/multiselect/quantity/filter and confirmation markup with capability fallback
telegram_patterns.aiogram.selection_router: ACK-first composition with fresh server spec, safe callback guards and host-owned hooks

groups.title: Календарь, время и транзакционная запись
groups.limits: SDK-free; Europe/Warsaw needs host IANA database or optional calendar extra (tested tzdata 2026.5). Current synchronous host ACL inside file SQLite transaction before effect/replay. Publish is trusted host CAS; immutable receipt differs from current booking; no external side effects. Host owns file/migrations/retention and async shutdown work.

telegram_patterns.CalendarMonth: Immutable Monday-first month, available/blocked dates and plain summary
telegram_patterns.TimeSlot: Half-open UTC interval and local offset display
telegram_patterns.resolve_local_time: Naive wall time to UTC, DST gap rejection and explicit ambiguous fold
telegram_patterns.SlotBooking: Current owner-bound booking status and immutable times
telegram_patterns.SQLiteSlotStore: Explicit schema, schedule CAS, current ACL, atomic reserve/cancel and replay

groups.title: Кнопки календаря и времени
groups.limits: Optional aiogram; markup only. Callback data must be owner/context/revision bound by controller; the booking transaction rechecks availability. Default weekday fallback omits unavailable days. disabled_buttons=True requires explicit host-verified support; no live/device claim.

telegram_patterns.aiogram.calendar_keyboard: Available-date fallback or native disabled month grid with explicit navigation
telegram_patterns.aiogram.time_slot_keyboard: Enabled UTC intervals displayed with local offset, native layout/validation

groups.title: Число, email, телефон, дата, файл, контакт и геопозиция
groups.limits: Optional aiogram. Ordinary private chat; host FSM/event isolation and durable same-intent business transaction. ForceReply author/step correlation; native candidates require confirmation. Metadata and coordinates do not prove content/identity/presence. No live/device acceptance.

telegram_patterns.aiogram.ContactField: Own or explicitly third-party contact candidate
telegram_patterns.aiogram.DialogSubmission: Immutable identity and values; fresh as_dict
telegram_patterns.aiogram.dialog_form_router: Mixed router with owner/step guards, back/cancel and confirmation

groups.title: Медиа, альбомы и ограниченное скачивание
groups.limits: Optional aiogram; requests do not send. Typed byte upload or same-bot file_id, no codec validation/ACL guarantee. 2..10 compatible album items, 1024 UTF-16 caption, inline upload rejected. Explicit hosted bounded download closes stream; local filesystem/URLs/unique_id conversion and automatic retry are absent. Host preserves native routing/rights and validates actual content.

telegram_patterns.aiogram.MediaKind: Literal photo/video/audio/document; исходный тип file_id проверяет host
telegram_patterns.aiogram.MediaSendRequest: Union четырех native send request типов
telegram_patterns.aiogram.MediaFile: Immutable bytes/filename или same-bot file_id, bounds и fresh multipart input
telegram_patterns.aiogram.MediaItem: Immutable typed source, literal FormattedText caption и presentation flags
telegram_patterns.aiogram.DownloadedMedia: Frozen bounded bytes и bot-scoped identifiers без URL/file_path
telegram_patterns.aiogram.media_request: Один native send request без отправки
telegram_patterns.aiogram.media_album: Один native 2..10-item homogeneous/visual album без batching
telegram_patterns.aiogram.media_edit: Exclusive chat/message или inline address и album type guard
telegram_patterns.aiogram.download_media: Явное hosted чтение с actual byte bound, total deadline и stream close

groups.title: Профили и разрешенное оформление собственного бота
groups.limits: Optional aiogram; immutable selected SDK facts, bool/None distinction and source/time do not authorize a user. Explicit native reads preserve visibility/locale fallback. Own-bot writes require fresh identity and current host per-method ACL; None omits, empty string clears locale, avatar global/new bytes. Host owns codec/content, serialization, caches and reconciliation; sequential writes/readback are not atomic, cancellation/rejected await does not undo effects. No Business/MTProto/arbitrary profile editing or live proof.

telegram_patterns.aiogram.ProfileSource: Literal update/getMe — объявленный источник наблюдения, не authorization proof
telegram_patterns.aiogram.ProfileAuthorizer: Async host ACL(actor_id, bot_id, method) → bool; read и точные setMy*/removeMy* имена
telegram_patterns.aiogram.UserProfile: Frozen numeric identity, optional text/Premium/capabilities и aware source observation
telegram_patterns.aiogram.ChatProfile: Frozen выбранные getChat данные, фото/permissions/birthdate и nullable facts
telegram_patterns.aiogram.ProfilePhotoSize: Frozen bot/user-scoped photo identifiers; as_media только для message reuse
telegram_patterns.aiogram.ProfilePhotos: Immutable видимая страница, total_count/offset/limit и observation time
telegram_patterns.aiogram.BotProfile: Fresh getMe/localized texts, optional own-bot ProfilePhotos; не atomic snapshot
telegram_patterns.aiogram.BotProfilePatch: None omission/empty clear, bounds и новый static JPG/animated MPEG4 upload либо removal
telegram_patterns.aiogram.ProfileEditIncomplete: UnknownOutcome с safe confirmed prefix и pending phase; требуется сверка
telegram_patterns.aiogram.user_profile: Копирование User без I/O, nullable flags и ownership snapshot
telegram_patterns.aiogram.chat_profile: Копирование selected ChatFullInfo без I/O; default permissions не actor role
telegram_patterns.aiogram.read_profile_photos: Один explicit getUserProfilePhotos, immutable sizes, без отрицательных privacy выводов
telegram_patterns.aiogram.read_bot_profile: Fresh getMe плюс три locale reads; optional own-bot photos, unrequested None
telegram_patterns.aiogram.update_bot_profile: Текущий host ACL перед каждым выбранным own-bot методом и fresh readback; без retry/rollback

groups.title: Inline-поиск и shareable results
groups.limits: Private items default to unshareable; personal Telegram cache is not secrecy of a sent inline message Host owns current ACL, catalog/permission revisions, durable secret, deadlines/concurrency and storage Personal cursors bind actor/bot/query/context/catalog; shared cache is fully public/all-context and actor-agnostic Positive server cache may replay old results without reaching the bot; restricted current-ACL composition uses cache_time=0 Cursor chain expiry does not slide; stale/denied/timeout answers empty personal, not an automatic restart Literal articles and opt-in verified emoji metadata; no native answer retry, chosen feedback or live privacy proof

telegram_patterns.aiogram.InlineChatType: Literal inline chat context, including explicit unknown None
telegram_patterns.aiogram.InlineAuthorizer: Async current host ACL(actor,item) → strict bool
telegram_patterns.aiogram.InlineSearchProvider: Async host provider of a fresh immutable catalog
telegram_patterns.aiogram.InlineItem: Frozen article identity and literal/entities text; shareable=False by default
telegram_patterns.aiogram.InlinePage: Frozen page bound to the original query; answer_request builds one native request
telegram_patterns.aiogram.InlineSearch: Bounded immutable search snapshot with HMAC cursor and fixed chain expiry
telegram_patterns.aiogram.inline_articles: Fresh native article/text models with explicit parse_mode=None
telegram_patterns.aiogram.inline_query_router: Host Dispatcher router with provider/ACL deadline, stale rejection and one native answer

groups.title: Опросы, quiz и доступные события
groups.limits: 1..12 initial options, monotonic multi-correct quiz, revoting and SDK rich media; native limits checked separately from local bounds Channel-only members/country restrictions and explicit declared chat/thread/business context, not server permission proof Persistent option IDs and user/chat voter identities; None and reported zero remain raw/possibly unknown Host registers confirmed own SendPoll responses, resolves current binding and persists Update receipt transactionally Unavailable poll_message cannot invent association; anonymous/foreign/unbound events do not give a voter ledger No getPoll API, implicit stopPoll, history scan, vote counting, create retry, media IO or live delivery promise

telegram_patterns.aiogram.PollChoice: Frozen literal option and cloned native SDK rich media
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PollOptionState: Persistent option identity and raw reported count
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PollState: Immutable native Poll snapshot with nullable answers and full JSON details
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PollVote: Selected persistent/ordinal IDs and exact user/chat identity; empty means retraction
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PollOptionAddition: Option service observation with possibly unknown poll association and preserved details
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PollBinding: Bot/poll/chat/message/thread/business binding of an own confirmed response
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PollLocator: Host lookup identity or exact address, always bot scoped
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PollEvent: Update ID, binding and one immutable observation
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PollObserver: Async host observer; owns durable dedup/state policy
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PollLookup: Async current host binding lookup, no hidden authorization
telegram_patterns.aiogram.poll_request: One native SendPoll request; literal entities, modern fields and no IO
telegram_patterns.aiogram.poll_state: Copy native Poll without count inference
telegram_patterns.aiogram.poll_vote: Copy native PollAnswer without inventing user identity

groups.title: Темы, реакции, заявки и специальные операции
groups.limits: Closed 51-method Bot API allowlist across seven families; native SDK requests and current method-specific rights, not arbitrary MTProto/account history; Host owns current ACL/resource/revision/connection/child bindings, media verification and eligible activity; Write requires an atomic durable sending claim; host budget/consent/quote are rechecked before native I/O; Local reservation and fresh native quote are not a remote atomic debit or financial settlement guarantee; Unknown result/receipt/crash stays the same intent; no automatic retry, rollback, reconciliation or global inbox/outbox promise; Join query uses original receive time and remaining native deadline; private topics support only explicitly permitted methods; Managed creation requires native user confirmation; token repr is hidden but host secret storage/serialization remain explicit; Story upload bridge uses validated SDK nested multipart; codec/dimensions/content and immutable file lifetime remain host duties; Events preserve unknown/anonymous facts; current binding and host dedup/order/revocation, no inferred actor or voter/account history; Experimental author SDK/mock/browser evidence is separate from live permissions, real devices, remote charge or independent human/AI acceptance

telegram_patterns.aiogram.PlatformScope: Immutable server bot/actor/intent/revision и точные chat/thread/owner/child bindings
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PlatformPermit: Текущие host policy facts, consent/quote и дополнительные права
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PlatformAction: Копия exact native request, проверка scope/params и immutable fingerprint
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PlatformReceipt: Безопасный method/outcome/result ID для прежнего intent
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PlatformResult: Receipt и native result; payload скрыт в repr
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PlatformHooks: Async host authorize/atomic claim/durable record contract
telegram_patterns.aiogram.SecretToken: Repr-hidden managed token с явным reveal для secret store
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PlatformEvent: Immutable native Update facts и preserved raw JSON; payload скрыт в repr
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PlatformLookup: Async current host binding по событию
telegram_patterns.aiogram.PlatformObserver: Async host observer; owns dedup/order/revocation policy
telegram_patterns.aiogram.platform_contracts: 51 разрешенный native метод с current method-specific rights и SDK sources
telegram_patterns.aiogram.execute_platform_action: Authorize/fresh rights/one claim/one SDK call/receipt без automatic retry
telegram_patterns.aiogram.managed_bot_link: Native user-confirmed создание; без I/O или получения token
telegram_patterns.aiogram.platform_event: Копирование native facts без guessed identity/history
telegram_patterns.aiogram.platform_events_router: Observers для разрешенных native events в текущем Dispatcher
telegram_patterns.aiogram.StoryPhotoUpload: Validated new photo InputFile bridge к SDK nested multipart
telegram_patterns.aiogram.StoryVideoUpload: Validated new video InputFile/duration bridge к SDK nested multipart

groups.title: Атомарное состояние и восстановление диалога
groups.limits: Structural host storage, exact six-field SDK key, one state/data CAS; JSON bound 64 KiB. Example dict is contract-only/nonpersistent; separate file SQLite and three-process proof in dialog restart recipe. Keep event isolation, migrations/tombstones, ACL and business effect dedup; no live/distributed exactly-once promise.

telegram_patterns.aiogram.FSMSnapshot: Immutable revision and detached JSON answers
telegram_patterns.aiogram.AtomicFSMStorage: Optional atomic capability on current project storage
telegram_patterns.aiogram.SnapshotFSMStorage: aiogram BaseStorage facade over supplied host store
telegram_patterns.aiogram.DialogLifetime: Absolute draft deadline without expiring pending effects
